features.summary: An element found by the id the view gave it: its text and HTML set to a literal or a source, its classes added, removed and toggled, shown and hidden, and its children and classes read as lists.
features.oracle: The HTML standard's textContent, innerHTML, classList, hidden, children, getAttribute and hasAttribute, as lib.dom types them in TypeScript 5.9.3, which the element's declaration mirrors (D5.3).

defects.defect: A note hidden by Hide shows again after Show, and a step on an element the page lacks stops its pipeline, so the step after it does not run (D4.1).
A seat's GetAttribute reads null for an attribute the seat lacks, a value: Eq("close") does not hold over it and NotEq("close") does (D8.9); and HasAttribute holds for an attribute with no value.
A text set from a value that reads nothing, an optional member its holder lacks (D5.3), shows nothing, and the step after it runs (D4.5).

promises.page: A pump card with its class list and a summary panel.
promises.gesture: Click add, remove, toggle twice, then the toggle whose name reads nothing, then load the summary.
promises.outcome: The card holds the class after add, loses it after remove, gains and loses it on the two toggles, and keeps its classes when the name reads nothing; the summary shows its markup.
promises.opposite: HTML set from a value that reads nothing leaves the panel empty, where the text undefined would show.
promises.defect: classList.add(null) adds the class null, and innerHTML set to undefined shows undefined.

promises.page: Lunch seating: two table cards, each with a seat list whose seats carry data-supervision, and a fall risk button.
promises.gesture: Open the page, then click the fall risk button of table 4.
promises.outcome: Table 4 shows 4 seated and 2 needing close supervision, and its flag count rises by one after the click.
promises.opposite: A station whose list holds a paged result stops at the count, and the text the step after it sets keeps its text.
promises.defect: An operation that calls filter on an HTMLCollection stops, or a count over a value with no iterator shows 0.

promises.page: A card loaded into a slot, with a button that sets the slot's text.
promises.gesture: Load the card, then click the button.
promises.outcome: The step stops with one error that names the slot, and the card stays as it was loaded.
promises.opposite: Once the card's plan leaves and the slot holds no loaded content, the same button sets the text.
promises.defect: A text write over a slot leaves the loaded card's behavior running under content it no longer shows.

promises.page: A note with Show and Hide buttons, and a button whose step sets text on an element the page lacks before it sets the status.
promises.gesture: Click Hide, then Show, then the button with the missing element.
promises.outcome: The note hides, then shows; the status keeps its text after the third click.
promises.opposite: Show on a note that already shows leaves it showing.
promises.defect: A step on a missing element writes nothing and the pipeline runs on, so the status changes.

promises.page: A table of four seats: two with data-supervision close, one with standard, one with no data-supervision, and one seat holding data-wheelchair with no value.
promises.outcome: Close supervision shows 2, not close shows 2, and wheelchair seats show 1.
promises.opposite: A count of seats holding data-hoist, which no seat holds, shows 0.
promises.defect: GetAttribute's null read as nothing, so not close shows 1, or HasAttribute reading a valueless attribute as absent, so wheelchair seats show 0.

promises.page: A rounds test component whose two buttons raise its NoteTaken event from its own JavaScript, its payload declaring an optional note member: No note with a payload that lacks the note member, and Ward round with the note Ward round. The handler sets the first status from the note, then sets the second status to Saved.
promises.outcome: The first status is empty and the second shows Saved.
promises.opposite: Clicking Ward round, the first status shows Ward round.
promises.defect: The missing note shown as the text undefined or null, or the missing value stopping the pipeline so the second status keeps its text.
